testsuite.name: com.chimali.fido2.data.transport.BleNotificationWriterTest

testcase.name: keepalives are suppressed once terminal response transmission begins()
explicit stalled-session abort is fenced by the current session()
keepalive notifications are coalesced when already pending()
terminal notification callback reports GATT acknowledgement()
queue capacity overflow rejects packet and aborts session()
clear drains pending queue and cancels in-flight timeout()
terminal notification callback reports failure when queued response is cleared()
queue capacity includes the notification currently owned by the sender()
enqueuing sends first packet immediately and waits for completion before sending second()
in-flight packet is erased only after notification sender releases its borrowed buffer()
completion from cleared send cannot stall a successor session()
notification initiation rejection drains queued delivery and stalls session()
old session generation cannot enqueue work after reconnect()
five-second notification timeout triggers session stall abort()
failed GATT acknowledgement reports failure and stalls the active session()
platform exceptions while initiating notification stall the current session()
